issue.title: Narrow top-bar usage PNG tests time out in wait_for_startup on clean HEAD
issue.description:
Both narrow top-bar usage PNG tests fail on a clean HEAD worktree (55936f429, no local diff), reproduced twice (a focused 6-worker run and a full 13-worker `just fix-tui-screenshots` run), and the sase-17d.10.1 land agent recorded the same timeouts on both the cutover and no-cutover trees.

- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_provider_usage_indicator.py::test_top_bar_usage_attention_narrow_png_snapshot`
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_provider_usage_indicator_states.py::test_top_bar_usage_badges_crowded_narrow_png_snapshot`

Both time out in `wait_for_startup` at the narrow terminal size, so `fix-tui-screenshots` skips them after 3 attempts and the run ends `partial`, which also blocks stale-golden removal in a full update run.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails on every attempt: three recover attempts in the full lane, plus two independent clean-HEAD runs; same result on the cutover and no-cutover trees per the sase-17d.10.1 land agent. Companion node: tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_provider_usage_indicator_states.py::test_top_bar_usage_badges_crowded_narrow_png_snapshot.

evidence.note: Proposed by sase-17m.5.1.5 note #2 (epic sase-17m.5.1 land): its full just fix-tui-screenshots run again lost the provider_usage attention/crowded narrow top-bar PNG tests to 30s convergence timeouts (zero pixel drift), reproducing identically on the clean base tree; not caused by the agent-session rename.

Independent repro by sase-17x.13.land at master ea130c678 (2026-09-25): a targeted just test-visual run of both narrow nodes failed deterministically (wait_for() timed out after 15.0s, 3 failed in 29s together with sase-18y's node), and the full visual check at ea130c678 failed the same two nodes; zero relation to the Command Line epic.

Independent reproduction on a clean detached worktree of origin/master f648e88e4 (no local diff): both test_top_bar_usage_attention_narrow_png_snapshot and test_top_bar_usage_badges_crowded_narrow_png_snapshot fail deterministically with wait_for() timed out after 15.0s in wait_for_startup at the 80x24 size (also reproduced earlier at 15fa5cd79, 3/3 attempts under just fix-tui-screenshots). Found while verifying the collapsed-header XPROMPT card change; it leaves fix-tui-screenshots partial with these goldens un-refreshable.
